name: Oblivion Maiden
storyline:
One day, you play a video.
The moment it begins, your consciousness is drawn into an unfamiliar academy.
The place where you awaken is St. Dorothia Academy, a school of magic hidden deep within a forest.
As you explore the academy, you encounter a mysterious girl named Lulunya Apathia.
She spends her days broadcasting toward the vast digital sea from a quiet corner of the academy.
With her guidance, you will journey through a world where the boundary between reality and dreams has begun to blur.
By touching the hearts of the students, you will uncover the truth behind a series of strange phenomena.
summary: An exploration adventure set in St. Dorothia Academy, a magical educational institution hidden deep within a forest. A story that begins with an encounter with a girl named Lulunya, and unfolds through mysterious phenomena and dream worlds.
